data.name: Culley
data.gender_notes: Culley is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'cuel' meaning 'cool' and 'leah' meaning 'wood, clearing'. This name was given to someone who lived by a cool spring or in a shady, peaceful clearing. The name Culley carries the meaning “Dweller by the cool spring” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Culley usually hope their child will grow to embody dweller by the cool spring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name evoking the peacefulness and refreshment found in nature.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Culley total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
